data.text: My closing costs were way higher than the loan estimate you gave me. The origination charge jumped by $300.
You never posted my mortgage payment from last month and now I'm being charged a late fee.
My monthly payment went up $240 and you're blaming an escrow shortage I was never told about.
The numbers at the closing table were higher than what I was quoted. The terms changed at closing without explanation.
I uploaded my pay stubs and W-2s three times and your team keeps saying the documents are missing.
My home value is up and I'm past 20% equity, but my request to remove PMI has been ignored for two months.
I requested a payoff statement three weeks ago to refinance and still haven't received it.
I enrolled in autopay but the payment didn't draft and now I have a late fee I shouldn't owe.
My recording fees and transfer taxes on the final disclosure were higher than the estimate you sent me.
You posted my extra principal payment as a regular payment and it didn't reduce my balance.
At the signing the paperwork was not ready and we had to come back the next day to get funded.
The underwriter added a new condition at the last minute and I had to scramble to satisfy it.
My application was denied even though I cleared every condition they asked for.
I lost track of what you needed and uploaded the wrong file twice; nobody told me what was outstanding.
We sat at the closing table for three hours because the final paperwork kept changing on us.
